name: DRD — Deluxe Ranch Dressing
sub: Every commercial fat-free ranch I have ever tried was just nasty. DRD is no Hidden Valley, but it actually tastes pretty good.
text:
DRY MIX
½ cup buttermilk powder
3 tbsp sour cream powder
1½ tbsp salt
1½ tbsp onion powder
1 tbsp garlic powder
2 tsp MSG
1½ tsp dried dill
1 tsp dried parsley
½ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp citric acid
1½ tsp malt vinegar powder

PREPARE THE DRESSING
Mix 1 tbsp dry powder with 153 g nonfat Greek yogurt. Thin with about 4 tbsp water. Stir thoroughly.

CONVERSION
2½ tbsp dry mix replaces 1 Hidden Valley packet. Your larger recipe uses 2½ tbsp powder with 1½ cups nonfat Greek yogurt.

NUTRITION STATUS
Your powder estimate: 15–18 calories per tbsp. With the photographed yogurt, the small batch contains approximately 105–108 calories; the yogurt contributes 15.3 g protein. Powder protein is not verified. Finished batch volume has not been measured.
The prior logging estimate of 30 calories and 4.3 g protein per 60 ml is provisional, not a verified label.

RECIPE NOTES
Keep sour cream powder at 3 tbsp; 4 tbsp muddies the tang.
Source: your recipe and mixing instructions, October 23, 2026.
